title: 第14章 玄妙大明王，落子吉与凶
slug: 当不成赘婿就只好命格成圣

第14章玄妙大明王，落子吉与凶
不论是鳄魔铸骨功，还是神明感应篇，在此刻的陆景眼里都十分珍贵。
他心中极为好奇，眼神中也闪烁着不同于以往的光彩。
“这两本典籍，也许就将决定我往后的道路。”
陆景深吸一口气，拿起那一本鳄魔铸骨功。
翻开封面，只见扉页其实三行文字。
“以鳄为形，通铸铁骨，立武道之基。”
这三行文字的左侧，还刻画着一条狰狞的巨鳄。
这只巨鳄獠牙森森，皮肉僵硬，正作扑咬状。
从巨鳄虬起的皮肉中，隐约可见一根根泛起晶莹色泽的骨骼正供给巨力。
而那骨骼外围血肉中，厚重的气血正不断激荡！
只一眼，陆景便知道……眼前这一只巨鳄巨力之下，只怕是金铁铸成的大鼎，都能撞成粉碎。
“鳄骨在所有动物骨骼中，最为坚硬。
就鳄魔铸骨功一定非常珍贵，盛姿倒是有心了。”
陆景吃水不忘挖井人，想起盛姿，旋即又将诸多思绪抛于脑后，继续
鳄魔铸骨功，足足有八十一页。
其中七十二页，每一页都有一式武学，或拳、或腿、或体术。
足足七十二式武学，杀伤力尚且其次，动作姿势却极有讲究，因为在鳄魔铸骨功中，正是依靠着七十二式武学重铸骨骼，让骨骼成为武道之基！
“比如这一式鳄魔出水，双臂扭曲向后，右腿放置于左腿之上，全身骨骼紧绷之下，就好像要钻出深水，一击毙敌！”
“光是这体术中，就有许多细节，我还观看之不透。”

陆景刚刚想到这里，脑海中突然有一道赤红色的光芒闪过。
原本就仔细钻研铸骨功第一式鳄魔出水式的陆景，脑海中突然无比清明，眼神也变得犀利非常。
他凝望着书页上的注解，字里行间之间，又品出许多深刻的意味。
而那一副体术图在陆景眼里更是如同看了千百遍一般，个中的细节都尽数落入他的脑海里。
包括手臂扭曲的幅度，包括骨骼紧绷的程度，也包括双腿摆动的幅度……
这一切的一切之于陆景眼中，便好像是有名师教导，清楚到了极点！
“嗯？这是我上次吉象获得的参研命格！”
陆景心中欣喜。
参研命格作用下，参演典籍、武道、元神术法的时候，理解能力将会获得提升。
“这赤色命格，竟然有如此裨益。”
陆景喜出望外。
原本他还担忧就像是陆漪所说的那样，贸然练武练身会伤及本身。
如今，在参研命格的作用下，陆景就好像是有对于这道功法造诣极深的名家指导，断无伤身的道理！
“这参研命格乃是赤色命格，比起勤勉刻苦这样的白色命格，效果还要来的更好。”
陆景按捺下自己心中的兴奋，将鳄魔铸骨功典籍放在桌上，又拿起另外一本神明感应篇。
他翻开神明感应篇。
入目皆是复杂的咒言以及印决。
“诵念咒言、行印决，驱繁思，诛杂念，念头如登九重天，感应元神。”
陆景仔细体悟其中的道妙。
“这秘典中的神明，就是指元神！

元神者，魂灵之主，念头之集，元神强横，可以观世界之真，可以免无间厄难，可以渡雷劫，可以登天门。”
“以神驭世界，世界则尽入眼中。”
陆景一目十行，读了神明感应篇卷一。
“虽名为感应篇，可实际上，这一本炼神法门记载着感应、出窍、浮空、日照四重境界的修行之法，这倒是一件好事。”
“这神明感应篇中记载，所谓感应便是感应自身元神的存在，出窍则是元神出窍，浮空境定义也极为简单，只需元神能够浮空远行，而这日照则是让元神在烈日之下行动自如，不受日光炽烤。”
四重境界，每一重境界都十分神奇，令陆景心生向往。
与此同时，旁边那力可镇鼎的鳄魔铸骨功，也让陆景颇为心动。
“只是，我究竟应该选择修行武道，还是应当选择感应练神？”
陆景心中犹豫。
当他看到这两门修行功法，便已经察觉不论是练武还是练神都非常艰难，绝不可能一蹴而就。
这两种道路，在陆景的念头里，只能够择优而行，绝不可同时修炼。
否则念头分散，最终的结果一定不尽如人意。
“不过……那一门大明王焱天大圣观想法之下，我的五感、思维明显越发敏锐，我的肉体也在不断增强。
这不知究竟是何缘故……”
陆景突然想起大明王焱天大圣观想法。
“大明王观想法是从一道蓝色机缘中获得，赤红级别的参研命格，起到的作用就那般不凡。
这蓝色机缘中获得的法门，不知能否称得上一声神妙？”
陆景想到这里，不由凝神静气，脑海中逐渐勾勒出大明王焱天大圣的法身。
佛门印决、佛珠、道袍、发髻、第三只神目，以及背上的肉翼……
随着大明王衍天大圣法相逐渐清晰起来。

陆景的呼吸变得悠长，精神也变得通明…
时间匆匆流逝。
十二息时间转眼即逝，然后是第十三息、第十四息，一直到第十五息！
短短几日时间，陆景观想大明王能够持续的时间，再度增长了三息。
观想之后，不仅只觉眼前的世界更明晰了许多，身上虽有疲累，内里却又好像充斥着很多潜藏的力量，等待被开发出来……
“看来，这大明王焱天大圣观想法，真的是精神与肉体同修。”
陆景想到这里，不由得陷入两难。
如果没有大明王焱天大圣观想法，他必然会择一而修。
可现在，陆景念头中的野心，却悄然膨胀起来……令他逐渐有了些许的狂念。
“也许……我可以武道与元神一同修行，为他人所不能为。”
他念头雀跃，低头凝视着眼前的两本法门。
正在这时，陆景脑海中，又有一道光辉闪烁而来。
“君子待时，夺机而动，有大成就。”
一行文字乍现而来。
趋吉避凶命格再度被触发。
陆景感知脑海中流淌着的信息，眼神逐渐坚定。
content_en:
Chapter 14 The Mysterious King of Ming Dynasty, good and bad fortunes
Whether it's the crocodile demon bone-casting skill or the divine induction chapter, they are all very precious in Lu Jing's eyes at this moment.
He was extremely curious, and his eyes were shining with a different light than before.
"These two classics may determine my future path."
Lu Jing took a deep breath and picked up the Crocodile Demon Bone Building Technique.
Opening the cover, I saw that the title page actually had three lines of text.
"It takes the shape of a crocodile and has cast iron bones to form the foundation of martial arts."
On the left side of these three lines of text, a ferocious giant crocodile is also depicted.
This giant crocodile has sharp fangs and stiff skin, and is making a snapping gesture.
From the gnarled flesh of the giant crocodile, one can vaguely see the crystal-colored bones providing huge strength.
And in the flesh and blood around the bones, the thick Qi and blood are constantly stirring!
With just one glance, Lu Jing knew...the giant crocodile in front of him could crush even a large cauldron made of gold and iron with its huge force.
"Crocodile bones are the hardest of all animal bones.
The crocodile demon's bone-casting skill must be very precious, and Shengzi is really thoughtful about it. "
When Lu Jing was drinking water, he did not forget about the well digger. He thought of the grand appearance, and immediately threw many thoughts behind him and continued.
The crocodile demon's bone-casting skill has a total of eighty-one pages.
There are seventy-two pages, and each page has a martial arts style, either boxing, kicking, or physical skills.
There are seventy-two martial arts movements, which are second to none in terms of lethality, but the movements and postures are extremely particular, because in the Crocodile Demon Bone Building Technique, it relies on the seventy-two martial arts movements to recast the bones, making the bones the foundation of martial arts!
"For example, in this pose, the crocodile devil comes out of the water, twists its arms backwards, puts its right leg on top of the left leg, and the bones of the whole body are tense, as if it is trying to get out of the deep water and kill the enemy with one strike!"
"Just in this physical technique, there are many details that I still can't understand."
Just when Lu Jing thought of this, a red light suddenly flashed in his mind.
Lu Jing, who had been carefully studying the Crocodile Demon Water Release Style, the first form of the bone-making skill, suddenly felt extremely clear in his mind and his eyes became very sharp.
He stared at the annotations on the page and read many profound meanings between the lines.
In Lu Jing's eyes, it was as if he had seen the physical skills diagram a thousand times, and all the details in it had fallen into his mind.
Including the degree of arm twisting, the degree of bone tightness, and the degree of swing of the legs...
In Lu Jing's eyes, all of this seemed to be taught by a famous teacher, and he was extremely clear!
"Huh? This is the Shenyan destiny I got from Jixiang last time!"
Lu Jing was delighted.
Under the influence of studying the horoscope, when participating in classics, martial arts, and soul magic, the ability to understand will be improved.
"This red destiny is actually so beneficial."
Lu Jing was overjoyed.
Originally, he was worried that just like Lu Yi said, practicing martial arts rashly would hurt himself.
Now, under the influence of Shen Yan's Fate Chart, Lu Jing seems to have the guidance of a famous master who has profound knowledge of this technique, and there is absolutely no reason to harm his body!
"This Shenyan destiny is a red destiny. Compared with the white destiny such as diligence and hard work, the effect is even better."
Lu Jing suppressed his excitement, placed the Crocodile Demon Bone-Forming Technique book on the table, and picked up another book on divine induction.
He opened the chapter on divine induction.
All you can see are complicated incantations and seals.
"Recite mantras and perform seals to drive away distracting thoughts and eliminate distracting thoughts. Thoughts are like ascending to the ninth heaven, sensing the soul."
Lu Jing carefully understood the meaning.
“The gods in this secret book refer to the Yuan Shen!
The Yuanshen is the master of the soul, the collection of thoughts, the Yuanshen is powerful, can see the truth of the world, can avoid endless disasters, can overcome thunder tribulations, and can ascend to the gate of heaven. "
"Control the world with God, and the world will be in your eyes."
Lu Jing glanced at ten lines and read the first volume of the chapter on divine induction.
"Although it is called the Induction Chapter, in fact, this book of spiritual refining methods records induction, out-of-body experience, floating, and sunlight.The cultivation method of the fourth realm is a good thing. "
"It is recorded in this divine induction chapter that the so-called induction is to sense the existence of one's own soul, and out-of-body means the soul leaving the body. The definition of the floating realm is also very simple, as long as the soul can float and travel far, and this sunshine allows the soul to move freely under the scorching sun without being scorched by the sun. "
Each of the four realms is very magical, which makes Lu Jing yearn for it.
At the same time, the crocodile demon bone-casting skill next to him, which could hold a tripod, also moved Lu Jing's heart.
"But, should I choose to practice martial arts, or should I choose to practice telepathy? "
Lu Jing hesitated.
When he saw these two cultivation techniques, he already realized that both martial arts and spiritual training were very difficult and could never be accomplished overnight.
In Lu Jing's mind, these two paths can only be chosen and pursued, and they can never be practiced at the same time.
Otherwise, the thoughts will be scattered and the final result will definitely be unsatisfactory.
"However... under the view of the Ming Dynasty King Yantian, my five senses and thinking are obviously becoming more and more acute, and my body is also constantly strengthening.
I don’t know what the reason is…”
Lu Jing suddenly remembered the idea of the Great Sage Yantian of the Ming Dynasty.
"The concept of the Ming Dynasty King was obtained from a blue opportunity, and the red-level horoscope has such an extraordinary effect.
I wonder if the method obtained through this blue opportunity can be called a miracle? "
When Lu Jing thought of this, he couldn't help but calm down, and his mind gradually sketched out the Dharmakaya of the Ming Dynasty King Yantian.
Buddhist seals, Buddhist beads, Taoist robes, hair buns, the third divine eye, and the flesh wings on the back...
As the Dharma of the great sage Yantian of the Ming Dynasty gradually became clear.
Lu Jing's breathing became longer and his spirit became clear...
Time passes quickly.
The twelve breaths passed in an instant, then came the thirteenth breath, the fourteenth breath, and finally the fifteenth breath!
In just a few days, Lu Jingjing imagined that the time that King Ming could last increased by three breaths again.
After meditating, not only did I feel that the world in front of me was much clearer, but even though my body was tired, it seemed to be filled with a lot of hidden power, waiting to be developed...
“It seems that the concept of the Great Sage Yantian, King of the Ming Dynasty, is really a spiritual and physical practice. "
Lu Jing couldn't help but fell into a dilemma when he thought of this.
If the Ming Dynasty King Yantian did not have the idea of the Great Sage, he would definitely choose one to practice.
But now, the ambition in Lu Jing's thoughts was quietly expanding... and he gradually became a little crazy.
"Perhaps... I can practice martial arts and Yuanshen together, and do what others can't do. "
He was excited with his thoughts and stared down at the two books in front of him.
At this moment, another ray of light flashed in Lu Jing's mind.
“A gentleman waits for the right moment, seizes the opportunity, and achieves great success. "
A line of text suddenly appeared.
The fate pattern of pursuing good luck and avoiding bad luck is triggered again.
Lu Jing's eyes gradually became firmer as he sensed the information flowing in his mind.
